identity.name: Matt Rowenczak
identity.headline: Retirement Planning & Annuity Specialist
identity.positioning: I'm dedicated to empowering clients to be prepared for their retirement and ultimately accomplish their goals. With a focus on guaranteed income, growth, and protection of assets, I can provide clients with an approach customized to their needs. My personalized approach ensures that clients can be more confident and comfortable either in their retirement or whatever their life goals may be.
identity.serviceArea: Based in Georgia, I operate my office out of the Atlanta area, but I serve clients nationwide. Through advanced technology, I offer virtual meetings, allowing clients to engage in real-time discussions about their financial goals and strategies.

professional.bio: Matt Rowenczak is a Retirement Planning & Annuity Specialist based in Atlanta, Georgia, with 16 years of experience in the financial services industry. A U.S. Navy veteran and former Supply Corps Officer, he holds a Bachelor of Arts in Economics from The Ohio State University and an MBA in Finance and Marketing from the University of Georgia's Terry College of Business. He helps clients nationwide build retirement strategies centered on guaranteed income, growth, and protection of assets.

story.title: My professional journey
paragraphs: With 16 years in the financial space, I focus on helping clients nationwide secure their financial futures. I focus on effective strategies to accumulate or generate retirement income while protecting those assets from risk. As a Navy veteran, I bring a disciplined approach to financial planning, emphasizing the importance of preparedness and security.

I hold a Bachelor of Arts in Economics from The Ohio State University and an MBA in Finance and Marketing from the University of Georgia's Terry College of Business. My career spans from military service as a Supply Corps Officer in the Navy to a decade in corporate America. My experience enables me to offer valuable insights to clients navigating their retirement or personal financial journeys.
story.quote: My goal is to demystify the world of annuities and retirement income strategies, ensuring clients can confidently plan for a secure and fulfilling retirement.

compliance.text: Matt Rowenczak is an independent financial services firm that creates retirement strategies using a variety of investment and insurance products. Neither the firm nor its representatives may give tax or legal advice. Investing involves risk, including the potential loss of principal. No investment strategy can guarantee a profit or protect against loss in periods of declining values. Any references to protection benefits or lifetime income generally refer to fixed insurance products, never securities or investment products. Insurance and annuity product guarantees are backed by the financial strength and claims-paying ability of the issuing insurance company.
